name: Depth-Based Gaussian Pruning
definition: A pruning strategy that varies the pruning threshold based on the relative depth (z-axis value) of 3D Gaussians to preserve points at the far plane in forward-facing scenes.
summary: Depth-Based Gaussian Pruning adapts pruning thresholds by relative depth to preserve far-plane points, distinguishing itself from uniform pruning by applying aggressive near-plane and conservative far-plane thresholds.
